name_reason: Compliant with the global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix (game global) + audio_bgm domain (BGM/MIDI subsystem) + driver_handle descriptor reflecting the datatype (opaque AIL MDI driver pointer). void * matches the AIL_install_MDI_INI() return and the AIL_allocate_sequence_handle(void *mdi_driver) parameter. No Ghidra address residue in the name; no domain ID involved.
purpose: AIL (Miles Sound System) MDI driver handle for background music; installed once at startup and used as the opaque mdi_driver argument when allocating the BGM sequence handle.
logic_summary: Sole writer main @ 0x25C0D: data_fd2_audio_bgm_driver_handle = AIL_install_MDI_INI(). If the install returned non-NULL, main sets data_fd2_audio_bgm_driver_available_flag @ 0x53EF0 = 1 and passes the handle (PUSH EAX @ 0x25C1D, value still live in EAX from the store) to AIL_allocate_sequence_handle, whose result is stored in data_fd2_audio_bgm_sequence_handle @ 0x53ED0. The only memory xref is the WRITE at 0x25C0D; the read is the live-EAX reuse (decompiler renders it as the symbol passed to AIL_allocate_sequence_handle). Sibling of the DIG/SFX driver handle data_fd2_audio_sfx_dig_driver_handle @ 0x53EDC.
element_semantics: Single opaque 4-byte AIL MDI (MIDI) driver handle returned by AIL_install_MDI_INI(); NULL when no MIDI driver is available. Not an array.
comment_original_issue: src comment block (main.c lines 820-836) is already accurate, precise, ASCII, conclusion-style (correct datatype rationale, verified writer/reader sites, BSS zero-init); kept as-is. The Ghidra side, by contrast, held its content in PRE_COMMENT (PLATE_COMMENT was null) and was stale/non-compliant: it referred to the writer/reader function as fd2_main (the function has been restored to main) and contained a forbidden process-history note ("DEEP-DIVE NOTE ... Phase 2 B.1 ... Originally bundled into wrong 8B orphan ...").
notes: Verified in disassembly: 0x25C0D MOV [0x53ED8],EAX (write); 0x25C12 TEST EAX,EAX / JZ; 0x25C16 sets byte [0x53EF0]=1; 0x25C1D PUSH EAX; 0x25C1E CALL 0x3A953 (AIL_allocate_sequence_handle) -> 0x25C26 MOV [0x53ED0],EAX. Memory at 0x53ED8 is all zeros (BSS). Sibling symbols confirmed live in Ghidra: 0x53EF0=data_fd2_audio_bgm_driver_available_flag, 0x53ED0=data_fd2_audio_bgm_sequence_handle, 0x53EDC=data_fd2_audio_sfx_dig_driver_handle. Ghidra plate change is comment-only (PLATE_COMMENT created with src-conclusion content + stale PRE_COMMENT cleared); no game logic, symbol name, or type touched. src comment unchanged, so the staged diff for main.c should be empty.
